{{Quote|Frankly, Master Luke, I think splashing around in the '''water''' before we abandoned ship may have corroded his '''perception filaments''' because I don't detect--|C-3PO about R2-D2|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 12">[[Star Wars (1977) 12|''Star Wars'' (1977) 12]]</ref>}}
'''Perception filaments''' were components of [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droids]] like [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. They could be corroded by water, according to [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]].<ref name="SWO_ALTA_V1_208">[[Star Wars Omnibus: A Long Time Ago.... Volume 1]]</ref>
